Understanding Email Warmup

What Email Warmup Actually Does

When you start sending emails from a new or inactive domain, inbox providers instantly become cautious. Too many new emails at once can make your domain look risky, which often leads to spam or low deliverability.

Email warmup fixes this by slowly building trust between your domain and inbox providers. With 360Airo, everything is automated so the warmup feels natural, safe, and consistent.

Before you begin, connect and authenticate your domain through Domains & Emails to create a strong base for your warmup.

How 360Airo Builds Your Sender Reputation

Four Steps to Inbox Success

This careful build up is one of the reasons 360Airo stands out among the best email warmup tools today.

01

A Safe, Gradual Ramp Up

We start small and increase your sending volume only when your domain shows positive engagement. This protects your reputation and keeps your domain aligned with what inbox providers expect.

02

Real Interactions That Count

Warmup emails are opened, replied to, and even marked as important by real verified accounts. These interactions look authentic and help inbox providers trust your domain faster.

03

Full Visibility and Control

Monitor every stage of your warmup inside the Email campaign analytics panel. Track deliverability score, domain reputation, spam signals, and email health - all transparent and understandable.

04

Long Term Protection

Instead of warming your domain once, 360Airo keeps watching for spam traps, bounce issues, and blacklist risks. Use warmup insights directly inside your Email Sequences to improve timing and conversions.
